recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Further edits would only duplicate guidance already present in the active Diagnostics module unless the work group later chooses a broader redesign of module use-case prose.
issue_request: FHIR-11480 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request from the DSTU2 ballot asking the Diagnostics module to include planning or recommendation of diagnostic-test performance as a use case, adapting Workflow module language and referencing CarePlan where appropriate.

additional_context: The current diagnostics module is in active build/navigation scope through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini. A later FHIR-40540/FHIR-39168 refactor in ab140a0db3a7364c07db3fe81f9203b6505099652b reorganized the page but preserved the planning/recommendation semantics, while later resource-link updates now use current ServiceRequest and DiagnosticReport examples. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant contrary community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/diagnostics-module.html:346-361 already says diagnostic resources are used to plan, recommend, order, and report diagnostics, includes a CarePlan planning example, and links recommendation guidance to the Clinical Reasoning module.
